production.note: US model years. First: The Auto Channel's 2001 Porsche review (autochannel-2001-porsche) describes the new 911 Turbo for 2001 and KBB lists a "911 Turbo Coupe 2D" for 2001 (kbb-911-2001-specs). The coupe is listed through 2004 (kbb-911-2004-specs: "2004 Porsche 911 Turbo Coupe 2D", "2004 Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet 2D"); for 2005 KBB lists the Turbo Cabriolet 2D (and the separate Turbo S) but no non-S Turbo coupe. The Turbo S is a separate trim, not part of this record.

body.note: Coupe from 2001; the Cabriolet (KBB: "2004 Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet 2D") from 2004.

transmission.note: "The standard transmission is a six-speed manual, but, for the first time in the Turbo, a five-speed 'Tiptronic' automatic with manual shifting is offered." Excellence: "6-speed manual, 5-speed Tiptronic S".

powerHp.note: PROVISIONAL: a named-author publication spec line, not a Porsche page. Quote (The Auto Channel, Carey Russ): "Peak horsepower: 415 @ 6000 rpm". Agreeing: Excellence magazine's 2001 911 Turbo spec page "415 @ 6000 rpm" (excellence-2001-911-turbo), MotorWeek "415" (motorweek-2001-911-turbo), KBB "415 @ 6000 RPM" for 2001 and 2004 (kbb-911-2001-specs, kbb-911-2004-specs; database). The optional X50 power kit and the Turbo S are not part of this record.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL: an unsigned magazine spec page and a database, agreeing. Coupe, 6-speed manual. Quote (Excellence, 2001 911 Turbo Coupe): "3,395 lbs. manual/3,494 lbs. Tiptronic S". KBB (database) for the 2001 911 Turbo Coupe 2D: "3395 pounds" (kbb-911-2001-specs); KBB lists 3,388 lb for 2004 (kbb-911-2004-specs).

provisionalNote: Power and weight are provisional. Power (415 hp) rests on a named-author Auto Channel spec line, agreeing with Excellence, MotorWeek and KBB. Weight (3,395 lb, manual coupe) rests on Excellence magazine's unsigned spec page and KBB (database), agreeing. A Porsche Cars North America press kit or brochure for the 2001 911 Turbo, or a Car and Driver, Road & Track or MotorTrend spec panel, would replace both. Production years rest on KBB year listings.
